correctness.rationale: The forbidden factor ABC has three nonempty equal-length blocks, each of B,C equal to A or reverse(A). Avoidance is factorial. Any new prohibited factor on adding a bit ends at that bit, so checking suffixes of lengths 3m for every possible m is logically exhaustive. A new independent prefix search gave exact surviving counts at lengths 0..10: [1,2,4,6,10,16,18,12,10,6,0] and exact length-9 survivors 001101100, 001101101, 010010011, 101101100, 110010010, 110010011; whole-factor condition and complement/reversal action partition them into orbits of sizes 2 and 4. Zero survivors at 10 proves no longer words, not merely a time-limited search.
